verdict.rationale: Ente docs state cloud backups are end-to-end encrypted (docs-27, docs-34) and local backups are encrypted with a password-derived key that Ente cannot recover (docs-9, docs-12), plus open-source apps/server are confirmed (probe-rt-2), supporting a 'vendor never holds key' claim. However there is no detailed cryptographic design doc (key derivation algorithm, protocol specifics, audit report) in the evidence, only high-level marketing/FAQ statements. Missing for 10: a published encryption whitepaper or technical spec, and independent security audit/corroboration of the E2E design.
